process: Just-in-time cards from approved designs; each card runs the drift protocol and updates this index as if merged. Session execution and queued deployed acceptance follow docs/SESSION-START.md. Session PR counts are informational; combine related approved slices and checkpoint for context safety. Owner-requested throughput measurement: average 400–800 changed production-code lines and 2–5 fully completed slices per substantive PR; record actual diffs/slice evidence and use session:status for remaining indexed units. These are advisory averages, never padding or acceptance claims. Owner clarification 2026-10-14: PR workload accounting counts whole predefined batch subsections in the authoritative roadmap/design, never a function, UI hookup, guard, helper or execution-packet subtask. Partial subsections count zero completed batch subsections; count each subsection once with full eligible engineering and pre-merge evidence. Group related subsections into substantial PRs; use focused checks during work and full required gates on the coherent PR. Existing acceptance and safety gates remain.
